theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_te_l1d_compact_sign_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Eucl n → ℝ), Integrable w → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K₁ K₂ : Set (Eucl n), IsCompact K₁ ∧ IsCompact K₂ ∧ Disjoint K₁ K₂ ∧ ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x ∈ K₁, g x = 1) → (∀ x ∈ K₂, g x = -1) → (∫ x, |w x|) < (∫ x, w x * g x) + ε
